run_eval_lm_cli: run the fairseq eval_lm CLI to evaluate a trained language model perplexity
run_eval_lm_function: run the eval_lm function to compute perplexity and loss for a list of FairseqModel instances
run_main_entry: run the main entry point to load models and evaluate language model perplexity from config
review_WordStat_class: review the WordStat class that tracks word log probabilities, counts, and BPE status during evaluation
summarize_eval_lm_function: summarize the eval_lm function that scores sequences using SequenceScorer and computes average negative log likelihood
